whatToWatch.text: The bounce-back spot: 4-4 and coming off a loss, Seattle gets Arizona at home as an 8.5-point favorite — this is the kind of game good teams are supposed to take, and the crowd should treat it that way.

Strength on strength... sort of: Seattle's defense is giving up 19.9 points per game, Arizona's is bleeding 29.75. Both sides get to the quarterback at the same 2.25 sacks per game clip, so whoever wins on the line wins the day — and the 39.5 total says Vegas expects a grinder.

Availability watch: five Seahawks are questionable, including Charles Cross and Leonard Williams, plus Quenton Nelson — big names on both lines. Arizona's already down four, so depth guys on both sidelines will decide more snaps than the betting line suggests.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock steps back under center at Lumen Field with Sam Darnold sidelined by a quad injury — the second time this season Seattle faces Arizona without its starting quarterback, after Darnold's glute kept him out of the Week 2 rematch in the desert. Mike Macdonald's banged-up QB room got reinforcements this week in former UFL MVP Adrian Martinez, signed off the 49ers' roster before Wednesday's practice. The Seahawks will break out the college navy jersey-and-pants combination for the occasion.
